queries.query_policy: Generation and validation-selection classifier calls; held-out test reporting occurs in revision.evaluate

notes: Rules selected/ranked on D_val; all reported metrics on D_test (n=36). Union over top-k=5 ranked by precision_coverage (score = fid * (1 + cov) when formula is precision_coverage); best = rank-1 of that same set. Empty boxes -> NaN precision. min_support=10. Cells with n_covered < min_support are statistically uninformative.
